subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Should this PR wait for a stable OpenClaw release containing the startup-lease fix, or should its setup-independent changes be split while the LKG update remains deferred?
rationale: Automation cannot choose a supported release line when the current stable package is known to block first-run setup and the candidate fixed package is still a prerelease.

options.title: Wait for fixed stable
options.body: Retarget the LKG when the upstream lease fix ships in stable and require all official-package WSL setup shards to pass before merging.

options.title: Split the safe subset
options.body: Move the culture-invariant formatting into a narrow PR and defer the package and Gateway lifecycle changes until their real setup proof is green.

options.title: Accept the known failure
options.body: Merge 2026.7.1 despite the deterministic setup outage and explicitly own the blocked first-run experience until a follow-up release.

recommendation.title: Wait for fixed stable
recommendation.body: Retarget the LKG when the upstream lease fix ships in stable and require all official-package WSL setup shards to pass before merging.
